See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} The '''U.S. federal agents''' are officers of the [[United States government|federal government]] before the [[Great War]] who appear in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== These federal agents operated under the authority of the [[House Un-American Activities Committee]], enacting an arrest warrant on [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Strip]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ==Appearances== The U.S. federal agents appear only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|16=208}} ==Behind the scenes== * The federal agent with a speaking role in "[[The Strip]]" is portrayed by [[Henry Noble]]. There are other federal agents who assist in the arrest, portrayed by uncredited extras who do not speak in the episode, including [[Victor Mambu]]. * The [[wikipedia:House Un-American Activities Committee|House Un-American Activities Committee]] was a real-world conference that existed from 1938 to 1975 with the goal of investigating disloyalty to the [[United States of America|United States]] and [[Communism|communist]] sympathies on the domestic front. It appears to have continued existence into [[Timeline (2050-2099)#2077|2077]] following the [[Divergence]]. It is currently unconfirmed in which way the House Un-American Activities Committee interacted, if at all, with the [[U.S. Center of Anti-American Activities]], which is mentioned in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== Federal agent1 The Strip.png|Played by [[Henry Noble]] Federal agent1-2 The Strip.png Federal agent2 The Strip.png|Played by [[Victor Mambu]] {{Stub|FOTV}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
